question: How does GPS depend on light being equally fast in every direction?
answer: GPS turns each pulse's travel time into a distance. That only works if light moves at the same speed in every direction. Drag the slider to let light run faster leftward than rightward.
move: GPS is built on an assumption: light's speed is the same in all directions.
